'''Braynor''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was the overseer of the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], where he thanked an Imperial for taking out the entire [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] force threatening the [[Dorn Base]].
